answer: Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The design leans on honeypot tasks with known-bad answers, re-queued for a second panel, no identity may audit its own recruit. What survives to the nectar is a record of labour, not a list of addresses. The falcon holds work receipts rather than names, so the ember of a duplicated claim is visible before it can spread.
